status: Adaptive engineering on the previously inspected archive; not independent validation
hypothesis: Separately selecting host and fused parameters for latency error can produce a poor difference and wrong ranking. Test joint training-only selection before adding new feature families.
grid: The existing 48 host parameter settings and 12 fused settings; score all 576 pairs on inner held-out groups. Fit each component only once per setting and fold.
loss_unit: One shape contributes one regret; worst_group_mean is the worst mean among inner held-out acquisition groups. Paired MSE compares fused-host predicted and measured differences, normalized by held-out host latency.
selection: Smallest predicted absolute latency, symmetric host/fused comparison, exact ties favor host. Retain training-derived grouped-N eligibility in both inner CV and inference.
unchanged: All absolute component features, NNLS solver, weighting and regularization grids are inherited from previously reviewed traffic/resource models. No new shape thresholds, no model-specific offset, no final-test-label input to fitting.
acceptance: Original primary and leave-K gates, six exact M512 selections, all training-group deletions, previous adversarial replay and the same 34 one-percent stresses. A mean gain cannot override a failed boundary gate.
stop_rule: Finish these three declared alternatives and report every result. Do not change the trial definitions in response to outer failures; do not replace the default compiler or frozen GPU package.
